vb_textbox.text: Go predominantely for the green and brown gnomes. Once they start dropping to +1 or +2, switch up to the red and pinkish gnomes for 4 or 5 rounds, then switch back to the green and brown gnomes. I found that the forest that the green and brown knomes pick from (the forest with the purple tree trunks) seemed to have a bigger harvest of mushrooms than the other forest where the red and pinkish knomes pick from. Also, you'll be surprised how often you forget to press the space bar once you're in the forest. I think I missed about 6 rounds of points because of it, so try not to do the same. I should also add that the most points I got from one round was +9, and the lowest was 0. Therefore, anything around the 5+ mark for a round is pretty good. I did find that the points slowed down quite a lot whichever gnome I picked towards the end of the game, so try not to be too frustrated if that happens to you too. Good luck my friend :)
